xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: The Company has received an Order-in-Original from the Joint Commissioner of CGST, Faridabad with a tax demand of Rs. 962.89 lakhs along with penalty of Rs. 964.14 lakhs and applicable Interest.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: The issue pertains to valuation of consideration for the machining services and related processes by the Company for the period from 2017-18 to 2023-24.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: The Company has discharged the requisite tax on the entire consideration for the machining and related processes. Based on the above, we believe that the said demand is not maintainable and we are in the process of prefering an appeal against the Order. We do not forsee any material impact on financial or operational or other activities of the Company as the obligation has been fully discharged.
